items.title: Phil Schaap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: Him and Al Hibbler. Say, “Monk, who do you think’s playing alto on this record?”

ctx.x: What kinds of things did he teach you?

How to listen to records so you didn’t say something stupid. That’s an important lesson. Him and Al Hibbler. Say, “Monk, who do you think’s playing alto on this record?” And you’d say, “Well I don’t know.” “You can’t tell, Monk?” “No I can’t.” “Well tell you what. Here’s the record. Listen to it for a week. Come back next Saturday morning. But if you can’t tell me next Saturday morning give me back the record and don’t come here no more.” Now that’s a tough teaching — their method. I hope I’m not that mean. But…
I see. Were your parents thrilled that you were getting this?
